recognition.identity: compiler-resolved constructor/import symbols only; a Hono family import specifier AND an inventoried class declaration in a .d.ts are both required; name resemblance is never evidence
recognition.paths: framework type surfaces are expected as inventoried declaration files (tsconfig paths or granted type roots); unresolved constructors become unknown records, never ambient reads
recognition.runtime: no application is evaluated, imported, installed, or executed at scan time; no regex-only claims where compiler information exists

supportedSyntax: new Hono() / new OpenAPIHono() bound to const declarations, export default, or used inline
immutable const aliases of instances (one step, const-only)
basePath literal views, including inline chains app.basePath('/x').get(...)
verb methods get/post/put/patch/delete/options/head, all, on(method|methods, path)
route(path, childRouter) mounts with mount-time snapshot semantics and proven ESM initialization order across modules
use() with literal path filters or global; inline route middleware chains
c.json/text/html/body/render/status response sites with literal or in-scope statuses
createRoute({method, path, operationId}) and OpenAPIHono.openapi(definition, handler)
JSX returns, JSX in c.html, and c.render as SSR evidence; c.html(string) is html, not ssr
app.request(path, init) and testClient(app) flows in test modules
unsupportedSyntax: custom getPath / router path transforms (recorded unknown when detected)
mutable instance aliases, factory-produced receivers (unsupported-receiver uncertainty)
dynamic paths, dynamic method arrays, dynamic context keys, dynamic statuses (unknown/incomplete with reasons)
mounts whose target does not resolve (including import cycles: unknown, never invented)
ambient `declare module "hono"` without an inventoried declaration file

evidenceModel.record: closed envelope: relation, from/to native identity, method/path, facet, role, ordinal/unwindOrdinal, provenance (explicit|detected|inferred — never confirmed), confidence (exact|high|medium|low|unknown), status (complete|incomplete|unknown), machine reasons, 1-based span, source revision, adapter/framework version, rules revision, domain-separated freshness fingerprint
evidenceModel.freshness: the fingerprint covers registration identity/order/path, handler and middleware identity, structural signature and content digest, mount chain, facet, and span — any edit invalidates derived evidence
evidenceModel.budgets: 4096 records, 1024 uncertainty rows per scan; overflow is an explicit record-budget partial, never silent truncation

enablement.default: disabled; absent or empty policy keeps the generic scan byte-identical
enablement.wire: the closed target-protocol contract is not extended; full records stay in the adapter index and internal outcome evidence carries a bounded provider summary (state/counts/digest)

qualification.runtimeOracle: pending — mount/clone/order semantics beyond the documented snapshot rule must be qualified against a pinned Hono runtime before any claim beyond 'partial'
qualification.packagePin: none recorded: dependency version ranges are not exact framework versions, and no authorized lockfile pin was supplied for this repository
qualification.fixtures: tests/fixtures/node-typescript-scanner/hono (synthetic, authored declaration stubs; no real package, no conformance claim)
